record.body:
## Rationale

A blocking in-process full suite reintroduces the verify-budget pain (multi-minute serial runs that stall the agent). Background tmux in the phase worktree keeps the gate real while the session can continue or wait on dashboard/bell status.

## Counter-argument

Blocking is simpler to implement and reason about (no race between agent and tmux). The cost is returning to long idle agent time every phase close, which is why the full suite was removed from verification.

payload.choice: Background tmux full suite in the phase worktree
